program.instruction: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
program.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

requirements.text: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
requirements.source_phrase: Move the mug to the right of the headphones

outcomes.description: Move the mug so that it is positioned to the right of the headphones.
outcomes.target: The mug is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones.
outcomes.reference: The headphones in the image; compare the mug’s position with the headphones.

nodes.question: Comparing the source and edited images, is the source mug's requested move to the right of the headphones complete, incomplete with visible progress, or not made?
nodes.criteria: Pass only if visual correspondence establishes that the source mug is positioned to the right of the headphones in the edited image, satisfying the requested move. Fail if the source mug is identifiable and remains at its source-side position with no visible progress toward the right, or if it is identifiable in an intermediate position and the requested final position is not achieved. If the source mug is identifiable and evidence shows it remains at the source location while a plausible corresponding mug has appeared or moved toward the right, treat the move as incomplete rather than complete. Do not count an unrelated mug on the right as completion. Use unknown only when the source mug's correspondence or its position/progress cannot be determined from the images.
nodes.binding: Compare the source image's light-blue mug—including its body shape, handle, appearance, and original position left of the headphones—with all mug-like objects and any visible remnants in the edited image. Assess the pale mug left of the headphones, the mug right of them, and the blue-looking blurred patch at the far left as possible correspondence evidence; altered color or appearance alone does not rule out identity. Determine whether the source mug is still at its original location, has plausibly moved toward the right, or is visibly to the right of the headphones. Base the decision on source-to-edited visual evidence and the requested move, not on mug count or right-side position alone; retain unknown if correspondence or progress remains genuinely indeterminate.

program.checker_template: Evaluate ONE independent required condition against the SOURCE and EDITED images. No reference label, previous answers or optimization feedback is supplied. Return pass if the condition is satisfied, fail if it is not satisfied, or unknown if the evidence cannot establish an answer. Inspect only this saved condition, its criteria and binding. Report factual evidence and confidence (0..1 or null). A pass means satisfaction of THIS condition, not an overall edit label. Do not anticipate the optimizer's target. Missing evidence or transport/schema failures must not become a negative observation. The final overall label is computed by code; you never supply it.

d1: The trace correctly rejects completion: the right-side mug alone does not establish that it is the source mug. But its own evidence also describes a blue-looking remnant at the source location and a pale mug still left of the headphones, alongside a newly present right-side mug. That is evidence of some attempted change, not “no requested change,” so the all-or-nothing pass/fail criterion is collapsing visible partial progress into `no` and conflicts with the reference `partial`. Refine the decision node’s outcome mapping to distinguish complete, incomplete-with-visible-progress, and no progress: keep the right-side mug insufficient for completion, but assess whether the source mug’s appearance/location has been altered or a plausible corresponding mug has moved toward the target while remnants remain. Compare source-to-edited correspondence using shape, handle, color, scale, and location; do not treat the blurred blue patch as conclusive proof of either identity or no movement. Use `unknown` only if correspondence/progress is genuinely indeterminate. The trace is valid, queried, and dependency-free, so this is a visual-criterion/calibration issue, not a transport or schema failure; its 0.91 confidence merits review given the ambiguous remnants.

observations.evidence: The source light-blue mug is left of the headphones. In the edited image, a pale mug remains left of the headphones, while a separate mug is to their right; the blue-looking blurred patch at far left also suggests the source mug remains at its original side rather than being moved. The right-side mug therefore does not establish completion of the source mug's move.

findings.evidence: The source has one prominent light-blue mug left of the headphones. The edit shows a pale mug left of the headphones, another mug to their right, and a blue-looking blurred patch at far left. The left mug appears smaller and paler than the source mug, while the far-left patch is indistinct.
findings.rationale: The existing check discusses these candidates but its fail observation treats the left mug and blue patch as evidence that the source mug remains at its original side. Their correspondence is not visually conclusive; a focused identity investigation could distinguish an incomplete move from a completed move with residual or altered imagery, without assuming either outcome.
